summary: Renders a scrollable list area with viewport clipping. When this+0x160 (content height) is positive and ConditionalDelegation_6460(this, 3) returns a child, it computes the child rect size, derives a vertical offset from this+0x150 plus sub_4870E0 and a horizontal offset from sub_487060, clamps the area, draws the scrollbar via ScrollbarAreaRendering, obtains a surface through Accessor and blits it with RenderSurfaceFillCopy, and writes the clipped rect to a2/a3/a4/a5. Always then dispatches UICustomRenderDispatch with 800/600 viewport defaults and clamps the four outputs, returning 0.

operations.description: Snapshot outer bounds: v29 = this[1] (this+4), v30 = this[2] (this+8), and read the guard value v8 = this[88] (this+0x160).
Proceed on this+0x160 > 0 and ConditionalDelegation_6460(this, 3) returning non-null (child index 3).
Compute child area size: width v28 = v9[1]-v9[0], height v11 = v9[3]-v9[2].
sub_487060(this, 0) computes the horizontal offset v12.
sub_4870E0(this, 0) computes an offset that is added to this+0x150 (scroll position) to seed v13.
Clamp v13 into the window [v29, v30 - v11] and recompute v30 = v13 + v11 and v29 = v12 + v28.
ScrollbarAreaRendering(this, 3, 0, v13, v13+v11, v12, v12+v28) draws the scrollbar for the computed rect.
RenderSurfaceFillCopy(surface, v12, v13, v28, v11) blits the surface into the clipped rect.
Write the clipped rect to outputs: *a2 = v13, *a3 = v30, *a4 = v12, *a5 = v12+v28.
UICustomRenderDispatch(this, a2, &a5, &a3, &a2, &v28) dispatches per-item custom rendering; the locals are reset to 800/600 defaults and 0 before the call.
Clamp each of the four output coordinates against the values written back by the dispatch.
